# MillOS

> MillOS is a browser-based 3D grain mill operations simulator with deterministic logistics, production metrics, and a simulated SCADA workspace.

## Public resources

- [Home](https://www.millos.net/): Entry point to the current simulator release.
- [Simulator](https://www.millos.net/v0.40/): The publicly served current simulator.
- [Release matrix](https://www.millos.net/release-matrix.json): Public release inventory and archive identities.
